game.name: This War of Mine: Final Cut

trophies.name: Survive in Pogoren
trophies.description: Obtain all the trophies

trophies.name: Epilogue: War is over
trophies.description: The war ends some day. It did for me. I hope I am not the only one.

trophies.name: Diary: Day 7
trophies.description: It's been seven days since we holed up here. We survived for a week! So far…

trophies.name: Diary: Effing Snow
trophies.description: When the winter strikes Pogoren, you better be ready.

trophies.name: Diary: Finished ransacking
trophies.description: We've used every little thing we found here. We must venture outside.

trophies.name: Note: Bless the radio
trophies.description: The radio is useful beyond expectations. We get the news!

trophies.name: Note: Distilled gold
trophies.description: We finally managed to distill some moonshine. Always in high demand.

trophies.name: Note: Doubled the watch
trophies.description: It's crucial to secure our place against night intruders. Two may be enough.

trophies.name: Diary: Miraculous recovery
trophies.description: This recovery from a grave illness proves that medicines work miracles.

trophies.name: Diary: Patched up and ready to go
trophies.description: What good fortune! The wounds are healing nicely.

trophies.name: Diary: Back from the brink
trophies.description: With just kind words and deeds, we helped one of us survive the darkest moment.

trophies.name: Diary: Hostel's open!
trophies.description: We have now enough beds for everybody.

trophies.name: Diary: Shooting for five stars
trophies.description: For the first time since we wound up here all of us ate a hot meal.

trophies.name: Diary: First blood
trophies.description: One of us survived our first brush with violent death.

trophies.name: Note: Creature comforts
trophies.description: Our place is starting to resemble a proper home.

trophies.name: Diary: Traces of lives
trophies.description: Every building we visit has a story to tell. The more you learn, the better.

trophies.name: Diary: We Have Wintered
trophies.description: The winter's gone. The freeze is over. We all made it through.

trophies.name: Epilogue: We made it!
trophies.description: Many died, but we're all still here. This surely means something... right?

trophies.name: Diary: We've been everywhere
trophies.description: We've combed through all the neighborhood. Can we scavenge anything left?

trophies.name: Diary: We Made A Stand
trophies.description: The bandits came in packs like dogs driven mad with hunger, but we were stronger.

trophies.name: Note: A bit of indulgence
trophies.description: Coffee and smokes - sometimes that's all.

trophies.name: Epilogue: Exodus
trophies.description: Being forced to leave home is cruel. But when home is hell, you gotta escape.

trophies.name: Epilogue: New life
trophies.description: Livia managed to survive until the end of war and gave birth to her child in time of peace.

trophies.name: Diary: The Truth
trophies.description: Faced my demons and learned the truth of that horrible night.

trophies.name: Diary: Home Shelled Home
trophies.description: Finally found a way back to the old apartment. Or whatever was left of it.

trophies.name: Diary: Compassion
trophies.description: Some may need the clothes more than anything.

trophies.name: Diary: The doctor
trophies.description: The stakes were high, but I could not stay idle. I killed those soldiers, but I saved the doctor.

trophies.name: Diary: Good Neighbor
trophies.description: The winter was severe. I knew Tito used to help my father frequently. I decided to help him too.

trophies.name: Epilogue: All the way
trophies.description: Complete the game with all the alternate endings.

trophies.name: Diary: The Janitor
trophies.description: Zoran's destiny is fulfilled. We didn't burn any of our legacy.

trophies.name: Note: Fortify
trophies.description: For the safety, all the pillars in the museum have been reinforced.

trophies.name: Note: Burn'em all
trophies.description: Some people just want to watch the world burn.

trophies.name: Diary: Innocent children
trophies.description: They had only their adoptive father - Adam. Now they have a glimmer of hope to survive this war.

trophies.name: Note: The truck is ready
trophies.description: We finally managed to repair the truck. Now we can move our heritage to safety.

trophies.name: Note: The Colonel
trophies.description: We gave the painting to Colonel Markov. Our heritage should be safe now.

trophies.name: Note: The Fence
trophies.description: We gave the case files to Taras the fence. Our heritage should be safe now.

trophies.name: Diary: My dear Ruben
trophies.description: We faced the harsh winter together and made it to the Museum, our new shelter.

trophies.name: Diary: The Custodian
trophies.description: Milena's wish came true. We saved it all - our precious heritage.

trophies.name: Diary: Fool the Crow
trophies.description: We acquired the truck parts without giving up Anja's necklace.

trophies.name: Note: Malik on duty
trophies.description: Learn and broadcast all the news

trophies.name: Diary: You are a liar
trophies.description: Lie to Malik on two or more occasions

trophies.name: Diary: Thruthful
trophies.description: Tell Malik the truth at least twice

trophies.name: Epilogue: Heir
trophies.description: Finish the game as Malik's successor

trophies.name: Epilogue: Remorse
trophies.description: Finish the game apologising to Malik

trophies.name: Note: He is back home
trophies.description: Let Adem return to the shelter

trophies.name: Note: Roll-up master
trophies.description: Make one hundred cigarettes

trophies.name: Note: The school of life
trophies.description: It’s crucial that kids learn to survive on their own. What if we don’t come back one night?

trophies.name: Diary: Our future
trophies.description: We made it! Schools will reopen soon. From now on, kids will live a normal life again.

trophies.name: Note: Avoid the worst
trophies.description: Attacking a place that shelters a kid… Atrocious! We stand together to protect our little one!

trophies.name: Note: Better days
trophies.description: Kids… they sometimes seem to be far away from this war. It’s heartwarming.

trophies.name: Diary: Bond for life
trophies.description: At least the kid has a new playmate. Maybe it will even be a break from our daily routine here.

trophies.name: Note: Everybody got to learn
trophies.description: Solidarity. That’s the first thing we have to teach to our children.

trophies.name: Diary: Our own playground
trophies.description: We wish we could be kids again and have fun with practically nothing.

trophies.name: Note: No more tears
trophies.description: Nothing is more beautiful to see than a child smile and play again.
